sources.title: Separating Food (Food Safety for Moms-to-Be)
sources.publication: U.S. Food and Drug Administration, content current as of 2018-09-27

anchor.section: Separate, Don't Cross-Contaminate; Safely Separate; Clean Your Plate

evidence.note: FDA defines cross-contamination as spread of pathogens from foods, hands, utensils or food-preparation surfaces to another food; it identifies raw animal foods as possible pathogen sources and describes raw-food bacteria contaminating cooked food on an unwashed plate. Conditional transfer mechanism only; no food, contamination, hygiene state, dose, illness, safety or scene outcome is established.

labels: Контакт сырой животной пищи с другой пищей
concept_localizations.short_definition: Условная связь сырой животной пищи, контактных поверхностей и переноса возбудителей на другую пищу.
Conditional relation between raw animal food, contact surfaces, and pathogen transfer to other food.

claim_localizations.runtime_text: Возбудители с сырой животной пищи могут переноситься на другую пищу, в том числе приготовленную или готовую к употреблению, через руки, утварь или поверхности подготовки пищи. Это не устанавливает пищу, загрязнение, чистоту рук или утвари, дозу, болезнь, безопасность либо исход конкретной сцены.

Pathogens from raw animal food can transfer to other food, including cooked or ready-to-eat food, through hands, utensils, or food-preparation surfaces. This establishes no food, contamination, hand or utensil cleanliness, dose, illness, safety, or outcome in a concrete scene.
